svg.title: Shared task-conditioned control: independent test
svg.desc: Independent test means and one sample standard deviation across three training seeds. Fixed exact controls have no training error bar.

g.text: Independent test: 32 objectives (8 homogeneous, 12 distinct, 12 overlap); error bars: one training-seed sample SD.
Team returns are exact finite-horizon expectations. Within each run, all objectives use one validation-selected checkpoint.
